{{recipe}}

All ingredients in this '''pizza soup''' are added to taste—quantities don't matter too much in this recipe

==Ingredients==

=== Soup ===
*1 tin [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] (chopped, whole, whatever you like, as long as it has juice)
*[[Cookbook:Cheese|Cheese]] (type doesn't matter, just so long as it melts)
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]

=== Toppings ===
You can add whatever you like here in whichever quantity you like. Some ideas include:

* [[Cookbook:Ham|Ham]]
* [[Cookbook:Mushroom|Mushrooms]]
* [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|Peppers]]
* [[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]]
* [[Cookbook:Corn|Sweetcorn]]

==Equipment==
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]] (or knives, depending on ingredients)
* [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|Chopping board(s)]]
* [[Cookbook:Saucepan|Saucepan]]
* Cheese [[Cookbook:Grater|grater]]
* Spoon
* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]] (optional)

==Procedure==

# Chop the tomatoes and add them to the saucepan with the juice. Water can be added if necessary.
# Grate some cheese (for this part you should use at least a handful, depending on the size of your pan) and add to the pan.
# Add cornflour, if desired. Stir, and leave to stand on a low/medium heat until the cheese has melted. More may be added to taste.
# If desired, blend the soup to make it smoother.
# Chop or slice the toppings, making sure your chunks aren't too large (unless you like chunky soup). Add to the pan and heat again.
# Serve hot. Extra cheese may be added to top.
